The rain lashed against the precinct windows, mirroring the storm raging inside Detective Howard. He stared at the file on his desk, the evidence damning and undeniable. It wasn't just a mistake; it was a pattern of corruption that stretched back years, implicating his partner, Jack. For thirty years, they had been brothers in arms, sharing coffee, secrets, and the weight of the badge. Now, that trust felt like a noose tightening around his neck.

Howard’s hand trembled as he reached for his phone. He could call Jack, warn him, give him a chance to run. But that would make him an accomplice, destroying the very integrity he had sworn to uphold. On the other hand, turning him in meant ending their friendship, shattering the legacy of their partnership, and facing the bitter isolation of a man who betrayed his own. The clock ticked louder with each second, the silence of the office pressing in on him. He needed to make a choice, but every path led to ruin.

Orange.
